parts.name: Leg
parts.Basic_description: This is the leg of the pliers, typically made of steel with a rubber or plastic coating for grip. It is elongated and serves as the handle portion.
parts.Functional_description: The leg provides leverage and is the main part grasped by the user to apply force to the jaws of the pliers.
parts.Movement_description: It rotates around the pivot joint relative to the other leg to open and close the jaws.

parts.name: Base Body
parts.Basic_description: This is the base body of the pliers, made of steel, forming the central pivot and jaw connection area.
parts.Functional_description: It connects both legs and houses the pivot mechanism, transmitting the applied force to the gripping jaws.
parts.Movement_description: It remains mostly stationary, serving as the axis around which the legs rotate.
